name: Kousaki Noa
source:
A cheerful and independent stayer girl

She is the only first-year member of Sakurai Academy's long-distance track and field team. Full of energy, she loves running and eating delicious food (especially sweets) more than anything else. Her cheerful personality has made her popular with the track and field team, other sports teams, and cheer squad members. However, because she is so laid-back, she often loses track of time and lets her mind wander. She doesn't care about records or competitive results, so she never takes part in competitions. She is good friends with Toma, a Labrador retriever kept next to her, and they often go on walks together.
